implementation: Queued attempts have no provider deadline until HTTP 202 is committed; every POST has a committed owner token and bounded dispatch lease first.
Production app.main starts a bounded AnyIO watchdog from each worker lifespan; app factory defaults off for in-process tests.
The watchdog selects expired accepted attempts and queued attempts with absent or expired dispatch leases in bounded batches with FOR UPDATE OF generation_tasks SKIP LOCKED.
Watchdog and callback lock the task before locking the current attempt; timeout, failover creation, or refund commit transactionally.
A partial PostgreSQL index covers unresolved attempt deadlines and a second index covers queued lease recovery; Alembic 0004 adds paired lease-token/expiry columns and a consistency constraint.

The four plan-named watchdog tests, two lease/recovery regressions, and the original interrupted-dispatch scenario use PostgreSQL sessions and deterministic event gates where concurrency is exercised.
